Arjun Mehta | Mumbai | arjun.mehta@example.com

EDUCATION
PGDM (Finance), Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai, 2026 | CGPA 3.4/4
B.Com, H.R. College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai, 2024 | 82%
CFA Level I candidate (passed, Aug 2025)

INTERNSHIPS
Summer Analyst, Dalal Street Advisors Pvt Ltd (boutique investment bank), Mumbai | Apr 2025 - June 2025 (9 weeks)
- Built a three-statement model and DCF for a listed cement company for a pitch to its promoters.
- Built trading comparables for 8 listed peer companies using EV/EBITDA and P/E.
- Prepared 10 slides of a pitch book on sector consolidation for the director.
- Spread five years of annual report numbers for two target companies into the team's Excel template.

Finance Intern, Kandivali Textiles Ltd, Mumbai | Dec 2024 - Jan 2025 (6 weeks)
- Prepared monthly debtors ageing reports in Excel for the finance controller.

PROJECTS
- Equity research report: Valued a listed FMCG company with DCF and comparables for the Corporate Valuation course; target price within 8% of market.
- LBO case: Built a simple LBO model for a hypothetical hospital chain in the Mergers and Acquisitions course.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- Financial Modelling and Valuation Analyst (FMVA) - in progress
- Coursework: Corporate Finance, Mergers and Acquisitions, Financial Statement Analysis

SKILLS
Excel (financial modelling), PowerPoint, DCF, Comparables, IPO and QIP process (coursework), Capitaline, Bloomberg (basics)

ACTIVITIES
- Presented a stock pitch on a mid-cap chemicals company to 80 students at the college finance club.
- Head of research, Finance Club, 2025-26.
